scope: Seven specified primary full texts; targeted method review, not a systematic novelty-exclusion search

papers.title: Active Visual SLAM for Robotic Area Coverage: Theory and Experiment
papers.version: Author-lab 17-page draft dated September 25, 2014; not publisher page numbering
papers.finding: Empirical registration probability weighted expected measurement information; select revisit round trip versus coverage. Not a fixed-target fixed-scan local-dose study.

papers.title: A Unified Framework for Data Association Aware Robust Belief Space Planning and Perception
papers.authors: Shashank Pathak; Antony Thomas; Vadim Indelman
papers.finding: Simulate future observations, enumerate association hypotheses and posterior mixture, evaluate expected cost for candidate actions. Local rotations can be a special case of this broad formulation.
papers.integrity_advisory: Preflight UNAVAILABLE from unreachable-object xref warning, not missing full text. Poppler render and extracted Algorithm 1 agree. Advisory retained; no PASS claim.

papers.title: Probabilistic Active Loop Closure for Autonomous Exploration
papers.authors: He Yin; Jong Jin Park; Marcelino Almeida; Martin Labrie; Jim Zamiska; Richard Kim
papers.reviewed_method: Sections IV-VI; equation (9)-(10); Algorithms 1-3; Section VI first paragraph
papers.finding: Choose keyframe-cluster target using closure probability times uncertainty reduction minus travel cost; travel there and perform a 360-degree rotation. Adaptive trigger is not within-rotation feedback stopping.

papers.title: Exploration with Active Loop-Closing for FastSLAM
papers.reviewed_method: Equation (3); Algorithm 1; uncertainty-volume implementation; Section V-D
papers.finding: Retraverse history while current uncertainty exceeds both entry-time uncertainty and a threshold; explicit online termination. Motivation includes avoiding particle depletion in nested loops.

papers.title: Enough is Enough: Towards Autonomous Uncertainty-driven Stopping Criteria
papers.reviewed_method: Section 4, equation (6), window w and threshold Gamma_th; Section 5
papers.finding: Terminate whole active-SLAM exploration when percentage changes of D-optimality utility plus absolute mapped-area change are below threshold over a window. Not local fixed-target dose selection.
papers.extraction_note: Early pages have duplicate text layers; Section 4 checked on rendered original page.

papers.title: Topological Belief Space Planning for Active SLAM with Pairwise Gaussian Potentials and Performance Guarantees
papers.finding: Rank supplied candidate factor graphs by topological signatures and derive entropy/performance bounds under pairwise Gaussian assumptions. Does not itself validate which sensor measurements the backend will accept.
papers.integrity_advisory: Preflight UNAVAILABLE from unreachable-object xref warning. Algorithm 1 is partly image-based and was visually read in Poppler rendering. Advisory retained; no PASS claim.

papers.title: Graph-based SLAM-Aware Exploration with Prior Topo-Metric Information
papers.version: Author preprint corresponding to reproduced work; use its section numbering
papers.reviewed_method: Section IV objective and Algorithm 1; Section V-A steps 1-4
papers.finding: Optimize high-level visit/loop edges using D-optimality and distance; local loop execution follows a segment of past trajectory. Original V0 code returns up to seven XY waypoints and ends at waypoint completion, not verified accepted historical constraints.
